## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and `config/robot.json` are updated if hardware changed.
- [ ] Upstream reference files were not modified in place.
- [ ] Hardware status is labeled accurately.

## Hardware test

Describe the exact hardware, setup, motion, serial output, and observed result. Write `Not run` and explain why if no physical test was performed.

## Safety

- [ ] The robot was mechanically supported during initial motion.
- [ ] Battery disconnect remained accessible.
- [ ] No unexpected heating, reset, mechanical-stop contact, or uncontrolled motion occurred.
